decisions.reason: The new tip follow-up transaction and disclosure do not change when mint-success feedback should appear or which token ID it should display. The reported missing modal is execution evidence, not a value change propagated from the tipping decision.
The tipping interaction does not alter automatic fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, wallet contents, access paths, or confirmation-email contents.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported fiat methods, or the deferred lifecycle of the fiat mint flow.
An optional tip occurring in a separate follow-up transaction does not change the connected-wallet USDC payment flow or its requirement to complete the NFT mint.
The optional tip transaction is separate from the fixed mint price and required primary-sale revenue allocation, and the source specifies no change to those values.
The requested tip-transaction note is tipping-specific and does not change currency disclosure, ETH-versus-USDC selection, or the card-option state.
The source does not identify ETH payment or change ETH mint execution; it only changes the optional tipping interaction after a mint.
The tip follow-up transaction does not affect the exact-output ETH swap, excess ETH refund, mint-price target, or shortfall behavior.
The client requests a UI note for the tip transaction, not a change to the FAQ content, and no existing FAQ attribute is necessarily altered.

The tipping decision does not change code-used referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or limits. The absence of a commission in this no-referral test is execution evidence about another behavior, not a commission-rule modification.
The source does not change certificate-email delivery, contents, reading controls, or download behavior.
The requested tipping disclosure is a transactional UI note and does not necessarily revise any About-page copy or structured content.
